slogert:Application.description: Application, only used when there is no corresponding PID

slogert:Parameter.description: Fallback used when no other type fits the entity

slogert:Process.description: Process, only used when there is a corresponding PID

slogert:SourceHost.description: Host that generated the log message, e.g., mail-0

slogert:URL.description: A URL, starting with a protocol like http:// and ending with a domain like .com

xsd:dateTime.description: A date or time, which can include year, month, day, hour, minutes, seconds, etc.

xsd:integer.description: Any integer number, which can be a PID, a line number, a file mode, etc.
